mainDescription: Measure model quality, speed and consistency on the same tasks.
demoNotice: Simulated names, latency and token usage. These are not commercial model benchmarks.
tradeoff: Compare quality with median response time
partial: Partial results — wait for completion before ranking
costNote: Cost uses configured prices. GPU, RAM and energy are not measured through model APIs.
inspectNote: Compare each answer with its reference
first30: First 30 matching results. Export the report for all measurements.
emptyDescription: Choose models and tasks. Every measurement is saved.
resumeNote: Keep this page open during execution. Saved results remain available; resume after returning.
pauseNotice: Execution will pause after the current batch.
runningNotice: Pause the current experiment before switching.
error: Could not complete the request. Please try again.
setupDescription: Select models and tasks. Results are saved automatically.
demoHelp: Explore the evaluation pipeline without API keys or charges.
liveHelp: May use provider credits. Output cap: 512 tokens, or 4,096 for NVIDIA. Per-model policies are recorded in the report.
paidNote: API charges depend on token use and your provider’s pricing.
exploreDescription: Review the task text and scoring rule.
codingDescription: Trace code output, arrays, loops and recursion.
logicDescription: Number sequences, relations and multi-step reasoning.
analysisDescription: Compute sums, means, ranges and maxima from fixed datasets.
retrievalDescription: Retrieve reference facts from a supplied, closed context.
instructionDescription: Follow precise JSON keys, values and format constraints.
longDescription: Retrieve information from contexts of 400 to 1,600 records.
connectionDescription: Your API keys are encrypted on the server and are never returned to the browser.
keyHelp: Use a scoped API key from your provider. Your provider bills API usage directly.
modelIdHelp: Use the exact model ID available in your provider account; a fixed version is preferable.
simulatorDescription: Fictional models for testing the platform without external requests.
vaultUnavailable: Key storage is not configured yet. Environment-configured models remain available.
methodDescription: Transparent metrics, explicit limits and reproducible experiments.
method1: 240 synthetic tasks, with four templates per category. Every model receives the same inputs. This starter suite does not replace evaluation on your own domain data.
method2: Quality is the equally weighted mean of pass rates across tested categories. Errors, timeouts and mismatches score zero. Incomplete runs are not final rankings.
method3: p50 and p95 measure full server-side request duration. Consistency is the share of repeated tasks with identical answers; it is unavailable for one repeat. Consistency does not imply correctness.
method4: Token counts come from provider responses. Cost is estimated from configured uncached prices and is unavailable when usage or pricing is missing. GPU, memory and energy are not observable here.
method5: Coding tests measure code reasoning, without executing generated code. Retrieval uses supplied documents, not web search. Long-context tasks measure extraction, not autonomous long-running agents.
method6: Each run records task version, model IDs, repeat count and output limits. Provider sampling defaults are preserved. Ambiguous paid requests are not retried automatically.
promptLanguage: Benchmark prompts remain in English across interface languages to keep comparisons consistent.
addConnectionFirst: Connect at least one model to start a live experiment.
maxModels: Select up to 30 models per experiment.

error_INVALID_INPUT: Check the experiment settings and try again.
error_NOT_FOUND: The experiment could not be found.
error_BUSY: Another batch is running. Wait briefly, then resume.
error_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your saved results are preserved.
error_LIMIT: Complete open experiments before creating more.
error_NOT_READY: One or more selected models are not configured.
error_VAULT: Secure key storage is not available yet.
error_VERSION: The benchmark version changed. Create a new experiment.
error_ORIGIN: This request origin is not allowed.
trialTimeout: The provider did not respond within the time limit.
trialInterrupted: The request was interrupted and its outcome is unknown. It was not sent again to avoid duplicate charges.

trialProvider: The provider could not complete the request. Review the diagnostic code.
trialIncomplete: The model returned an incomplete or empty answer.
